candidate_relations.reason: Schwannomas typically show heterogeneous T2 hyperintensity and internal enhancement rather than homogeneously low T2 signal with rim-only enhancement. The MRI pattern (low T2 signal, rim enhancement, no internal enhancement) is characteristic of a hemorrhagic synovial cyst, not a schwannoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Schwannoma is a different extra-axial spinal tumor; does not account for the hemorrhagic/synovial cyst features

candidate_relations.label: Meningioma
candidate_relations.reason: Meningiomas typically show isointense to hypointense T2 signal and homogeneous internal enhancement with a dural tail, not rim-only enhancement without internal enhancement. The imaging pattern here (homogeneously low T2, thin rim enhancement) is more consistent with a hemorrhagic synovial cyst than a meningioma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Meningioma is a different extra-axial spinal mass; does not account for the hemorrhagic/synovial cyst features

case_quality_flags: Hemorrhagic synovial cyst at C7-T1 is an uncommon diagnosis; the MRI features (low T2 signal, rim enhancement, no internal enhancement) are key discriminators from the two candidates provided
Both candidates are plausible extra-axial lesions on clinical grounds alone but are excluded by specific MRI signal characteristics
